changelog: v0.6.6: New mobile HUD (designed and built by Colin's GPT/Codex session; verified, merged and published by Sparky). Touch controls rebuilt: procedural icon buttons, FIRE-drag aiming (drag on FIRE to aim while shooting), always-visible joystick base, PLACE/USE and CANCEL buttons for Forge placement, a weapon SWAP button, event-driven pause/interact buttons, and a touch-specific HUD layout. Intake verification re-proved the tap-can-never-fire guarantee in every state (menu, deploy, Forge open, pause, death) with a new behavioral suite, re-anchored touch fonts to the shared UiScale, and kept the project default emulate_mouse_from_touch OFF (menus enable it at runtime only). Web build updated too.
